items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: By providing clearer placement guidelines based on confidence levels, the system can reduce visual clutter in critical moments while ensuring essential information remains easily readable.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: Implementing a clear confidence display will enhance user trust by making the system's certainty levels explicit. This transparency will help the wearer understand when to rely on the system and when to seek additional information, reducing social awkwardness during interactions.
items.probe: Define the confidence score presentation format as `score + " " + label + " (" + short reason + ")` for V1.

choices.label: Label Only
choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.label: Label + Reason
choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.title: Memory/Cache Policy
items.summary: By keeping a local cache of frequently encountered individuals, the system can quickly retrieve confidence objects for likely new people without requiring cloud access, reducing latency and improving overall trust in memory support during conversations.
items.probe: Set a local cache eviction rule to retain faces and names seen within the last 10 minutes.

choices.label: Smaller Cache
choices.description: Bias toward tighter local memory and lower load.

choices.label: Recency First
choices.description: Bias toward recent names and conversations.

items.title: Phone/Cloud Boundary
items.summary: By keeping subtitle processing local, we can ensure real-time responsiveness and low latency, which are crucial for maintaining trust in the system. Additionally, this approach minimizes data transfer, conserves battery life, and ensures that the system behaves predictably even when network conditions are poor.
items.probe: Define one task-specific phone/cloud fallback boundary for live subtitle processing.

choices.label: Phone First
choices.description: Keep critical work local unless clearly necessary.

choices.label: Balanced Fallback
choices.description: Allow cloud assist for slower or richer lookups.

items.title: Visual Hierarchy
items.summary: This change will help the wearer prioritize important details, reducing cognitive load and enhancing overall comprehension during live interactions. By clearly distinguishing between high-confidence and low-confidence information, we can improve trust in the system's accuracy while maintaining a clean visual interface.
items.probe: Define one visual priority rule between subtitles and one-line support in V1.

choices.label: Subtitles Dominate
choices.description: Keep subtitles above all other overlays.

choices.label: Balanced Overlay
choices.description: Allow prompts to share attention more evenly.
